review: Original October Codex and Claude source-to-paper-rule adversarial review

scope.coverage: Read both original Markdown documents through all sections and pertinent methods/producers listed below; no analysis or producer rerun. No excluded new reanalysis/claude path read. Original claude-code research is included.
scope.limits: Scoped review, not exhaustive source-catalog audit or platform implementation. CH/CM/CT are outside this review; no claim their hypotheses are absent globally.

issues.title: Paper inclusion is not an executable contract
issues.evidence: 51 scoped rows are pending source binding; R rows omit global execution/risk/model dependencies. Future-work sentences supply no causal entry/exit/invalidation.
issues.correction: Keep paper_included=true. Expand every source arm/cell/target with explicit state transitions, bindings, hashes and common paper wrapper. Limitations are opportunity outcomes, not admission exclusions.

issues.title: Full-depth original stack and inverse lost
issues.evidence: FC10 omits bid_depth_full>ask_depth_full. FC11 is flow-only buying mirror, not exact inverse requiring ask_depth_full>bid_depth_full. Named FC rows omit full-depth agreeing/opposing, long-flow/full-depth crosses and equal alternatives.
issues.correction: Correct FC10. Retain FC11 and add exact inverse. Enumerate S00131 arms and alternative-book layers including equal/no-recent/missing states and both sides.

issues.title: Strict-pre feature clock is not a causal entry clock
issues.evidence: A family start is selected after it exists. Features use start_recv_ns-1, but original outcome includes family-group movement. Entry at that cutoff presumes future family identity.
issues.correction: Freeze strict-pre features but act only after actual family notification and adapter arrival. Keep source midpoint outcomes separately. Prebirth variants need a causal scheduled stream independent of future birth labels.

issues.title: Model target, units and frozen dependencies unresolved
issues.evidence: ST has7 targets; FB has signed/absolute at5 horizons. Absolute-price prediction sign is not price direction; strength-change sign means weakening/strengthening. M0 is not ST01: it includes book/raw flow. Method files and fitting code do not export frozen ST/FB coefficients. R model arrays exist in TRADE_RULES.models, outside register rows.
issues.correction: Expand target/horizon arms and bind exact transforms, arrays, coefficients, intercept, target units, training cutoff and artifact hash. Magnitude/strength stay their declared tasks; directional translations are explicitly new common protocol. Do not replace11 arms with M0/M1.

issues.title: Native-flow mandate is incompatible with original model substrate
issues.evidence: ST/DP companion classifies print against previous completed-group midpoint and bins at containing-group close; original detector uses action-time quotes. Operands differed21/863. Native-aggressor requirement cannot silently substitute.
issues.correction: Declare substrate per feature/model. Keep exact original companion equations for parity; native variants need separate model identities. Empty/unknown is not balanced zero.

issues.title: DP state and current direction compressed incorrectly
issues.evidence: Weakening is change in absolute half-window imbalance with both denominators positive, not signed imb_flow or path weakening. Source direction is current full20 sign, not birth. Early-empty and late-empty differ; DP07/08 combine steady, balanced-book, balanced-flow and both-empty.
issues.correction: Enumerate state x book relation x5/20/60 outcomes. Preserve separate half flags. Source-follow direction=sign(current20 imbalance); null/zero retained. Do not infer sell from negative strength-change.

issues.title: Full-day cuts and completed +60 bins leak
issues.evidence: Source computes activity terciles/strong-flow cut from all day rows. State/seed uses t0+41..60 and full t0+60 price/book bin. Anchor+60 precedes completed-bin availability at+61 and actual emission.
issues.correction: Freeze pre-paper cuts or separately declare past-only adaptation. decision=max(actual recognition,last required bin availability,classifier/seed emission). Preserve historical+60 coordinates but never use them as causal entry. Apply corrected event-relative horizons, never verified DAY0/1ns bugs.

issues.title: Nine direction sources and all pair cells undefined
issues.evidence: next_state and next_seed differ; next_seed undefined for S/X. Pair agreement uses all/high_vol/fast_high. first3 is first3-tick excursion, not3seconds.
issues.correction: Use exact formulas S00296:95-102/119. Expand all9 sources,36 pairs and their source populations, no highlighted-cell admission. Keep net300/net600/first3/next-polarity distinct. Quiet-momentum fade is separate multiplier=-1, not inversion of every momentum arm.

issues.title: Forecast correctness is future information
issues.evidence: Expected/unexpected side, next t0, next confirm and next_after_anchor are future facts at current anchor. Source retrospectively conditions on them.
issues.correction: Issue state/seed forecasts at causal anchor; attach correctness after successor recognition. Any entry at successor recognition is a new later-clock variant; cannot credit next_t0-to-confirmation movement. Preserve all5 original segment outcomes.

issues.title: Fresh label false and repeat survivors suppressed
issues.evidence: NEW_BEST/no reduction does not imply fresh add: repriced-in and older resting exist. R10 one-entry/order/session removes repeated survivors. R10 size_cut does not equal exact source enum size_cut_in_place.
issues.correction: Rename OL01 to source condition; preserve all origins and prior-onset0/1/2/3+. Natural key=session+segment+onset group+side, not order ID alone. R10 remains narrowed new variant, never proxy for OL09.

issues.title: Highlighted cells omit full one-lot experiment
issues.evidence: Missing source products include standing/no reduction, no_next, fill-linked/deep, unlinked crosses, prior-order crosses, age bins. S00279 filters missing tape and CENSORED before output.
issues.correction: Enumerate all original product cells. Outer paper opportunity ledger retains missing/censored/empty cells. Preserve NEW_BEST better/worse, both sides, source hour/session/ledger scopes. Do not equate usable completed101000 with total raw opportunities.

issues.title: 1ms timing and first-end labels are not fills
issues.evidence: Synthetic entry is first group at/after onset+1ms. BY_ENTRY includes equal-group end. Episode first-end and later order fate are separate; R10 20s is a different horizon.
issues.correction: At actual arrival recheck known episode status. Ended-by-arrival stays missed. First-end paper exit is first observed end after fill;20s R10 stays separate. Never use future filled-first or cancel<=5ms at onset.

issues.title: R composites are new choices, not frozen original math
issues.evidence: One-tick dual-quote confirmation,5s timeout,1s/two-group invalidation and risk caps belong to November wrapper. R9 expiry-flip5s differs from original20s aging/weakening.
issues.correction: Label R as new protocol hypotheses. Keep source-only original arms. Bind globals/models by hash; specify arm quote, confirmation comparator, zero sign, timeout ties, rearm/reset. Do not claim original October supplies those constants.

issues.title: Cancellation/support operands conflate mechanisms
issues.evidence: C can be fill cleanup. Native C size alone is not voluntary withdrawal. Modify reductions, reprices and unmatched reductions differ. R2 any-cancel versus positive residual conflict is undefined.
issues.correction: Specify same-order/price group fill-link accounting. Keep fill-linked/unmatched/reprice separately. State any-C versus residual-clear invalidation explicitly. Preserve ordinary aggression/no-rest and no-fill controls.

issues.title: Retrospective prebirth selection cannot drive online entry
issues.evidence: Controls exclude birth+/-60s, known only later. Birth-minus-lead times do not schedule causal opportunities; source provides no threshold or direction.
issues.correction: Use continuous/grid decisions and past-only features. Attach future birth labels/control exclusions only as outcomes. Retain leads1/5/20/60, missing/unmatched, quote-age and control-weight sensitivities. New detector/threshold must be labeled new.

issues.title: Narrative EX buckets hide tested dimensions
issues.evidence: EX02 includes weakening, became-undefined, fresh/expiry/mixed, saturation/participation. EX03 includes next-change and9 delays. EX05 has fixed delays and surviving/non-surviving populations.
issues.correction: Expand these source dimensions by trigger, timing and direction. Retain no-event/missing outcomes. Never assign pre-recognition next-change results to post-fill P&L.

issues.title: Original recognition baseline/contrasts not enumerated
issues.evidence: No scoped ID explicitly covers birth polarity after recognition crossed with same/reversed/balanced/undefined flow, predecessor SAME/FLIP, quantity, touch aligned/opposed/equal, prebirth depth, realized displacement and active-second touch controls. Narrow R and different DP studies are not equivalents.
issues.correction: Add complete original dipole-post-recognition cells at1/5/20/60/300. Birth polarity is known at recognition but not actionable at retrospective birth. Keep no-call/unavailable.

issues.title: Attachments do not prove every October hypothesis included
issues.evidence: Other named hypotheses: volume-floored detector; activity/state persistence and next-sequence outputs; sweep refill/chasing/withdrawal; large-jump/refill/external comparisons; negative S90/S92 applications. Broad EX/RG headings do not map these cells.
issues.correction: Explicitly map to existing other-family rows or add IDs; retain missing threshold operands rather than invent frozen values. Preserve original scope and source version.

integration_notes: All hypotheses and outcomes remain paper included with the same execution/reporting protocol. Performance does not control admission.
Superseded verified wrong clocks/math are replaced with correction provenance, not retained as active alternatives.
Original frozen equations and newly chosen execution/calibration rules must carry distinct versions.
Full-session raw-tape research and archived partial export populations remain distinct. Finalization-only events remain included with no causal live-recognition clock.

common_proposed_protocol.opportunity_record: One record per rule x natural opportunity including false/unknown/neutral, input failures, missed, no-fill, flat, boundary-censored. Undefined never becomes balanced zero.
common_proposed_protocol.known_by: Every operand carries event/receive/available ns, cursor, source version/hash and units. decision>=max(required available_ns). Ties ordered by close cursor. Completed second is unavailable at its start.
common_proposed_protocol.entry: After actual notification and required inputs known, submit the same marketable-limit IOC policy using contemporaneous side quote. Record actual send/arrival/ack/fill; old midpoint never assumed filled.
common_proposed_protocol.exit: Independent identified horizon variants. Paper origin (decision or fill) explicitly declared; source historical origins remain separate. First-event exit occurs only on observed event; no-event session end is censored. Same operational safety policy for all; original outcomes still measured if safety closes early.
common_proposed_protocol.invalidation: Invalid book/reset/gap records limitation and ends causal episode. Hypothesis signal failure is used only where explicitly defined. Fixed-horizon source has no recovered early-exit rule.
common_proposed_protocol.direction_translation: Use source direction where it exists. Absolute/strength/precursor conditions may not have buy/sell direction. If universal directional paper trials are required, apply the SAME declared LONG and SHORT overlay to EVERY hypothesis with independent IDs. Never relabel magnitude sign as price direction. This is a new protocol, not source performance.
common_proposed_protocol.risk: Independent hypothesis opportunity records. Execution caps may cause explicit cap/no-fill dispositions, never delete opportunities or introduce performance admission.
common_proposed_protocol.versioning: Replace verified bad active clocks/math; retain correction provenance, not active wrong alternatives.
